definitions.gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away; to clean by wiping
definitions.explanation: To remove dirt, liquid, or other substances from a surface by wiping with a cloth or tissue.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I wiped the dirt off the table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{濡|ぬ}れた→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wipe the dirt off the floor with a wet towel.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ (to wipe) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take/remove). Unlike ⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ alone, which simply means to wipe a surface, {拭|ふ}き{取|と}る emphasizes removing something by wiping.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: [object]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る
- No intransitive counterpart

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る: to wipe off sweat
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る: to wipe away tears
- ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る: to wipe off dirt
- ⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る: to wipe off moisture

ASPECT (ている):
{拭|ふ}き⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the action in progress (someone is wiping something off).
